_note: Official routes shown under 'Official routes that may apply', by topic. Fixed text: never generated by the model. Describe what each route is and its conditions only. Never say what the user should do, never say anyone is entitled or in breach, never give odds. Last checked against official sources: November 2026.

tenancy.name: Small Claims Tribunals (State Courts)
tenancy.what: Hears certain small claims, including disputes about a tenancy of residential premises.
tenancy.eligibility: Residential tenancies of no more than 2 years. Other conditions apply.
tenancy.limits: Claims up to $20,000, or $30,000 if both parties sign a Memorandum of Consent. A claim cannot be split to fit under the limit.

tenancy.name: HDB
tenancy.what: Sets its own rules on renting out HDB flats and rooms, separate from the tenancy agreement between landlord and tenant.
tenancy.limits: HDB's rules cover renting out the flat. Disputes under the tenancy agreement itself are a separate matter.

tenancy.name: Pro Bono SG (formerly Law Society Pro Bono Services)
tenancy.what: Runs community legal clinics that give free basic legal information and advice.
tenancy.eligibility: Means-tested, for people with limited means. Mainly Singapore citizens and permanent residents.
tenancy.limits: Basic advice at a clinic; it does not always include a lawyer acting for you. Current criteria are on the site.

employment.name: Ministry of Manpower (MOM)
employment.what: Publishes official information on the Employment Act, who it covers, working hours, leave and salary.
employment.eligibility: Information for employees and employers in Singapore.
employment.limits: General information; whether a particular rule covers a job depends on the job and salary.

employment.name: Tripartite Alliance for Dispute Management (TADM)
employment.what: Mediation for salary-related and wrongful dismissal claims between employees and employers.
employment.eligibility: Mediation at TADM comes before a claim can be filed at the Employment Claims Tribunals. Salary and wrongful dismissal claims are filed separately.
employment.limits: Wrongful dismissal claims have a time limit of one month from the last day of employment.

employment.name: Employment Claims Tribunals (State Courts)
employment.what: Hears salary-related and wrongful dismissal claims that were not resolved at TADM mediation.
employment.eligibility: Needs a claim referral certificate from a TADM mediator.
employment.limits: Claims up to $20,000, or $30,000 where a union was involved in the mediation.

employment.name: Pro Bono SG (formerly Law Society Pro Bono Services)
employment.what: Runs community legal clinics that give free basic legal information and advice.
employment.eligibility: Means-tested, for people with limited means. Mainly Singapore citizens and permanent residents.
employment.limits: Basic advice at a clinic; it does not always include a lawyer acting for you. Current criteria are on the site.

traffic.name: Singapore Police Force: Traffic Police e-services
traffic.what: Official service to check outstanding traffic offences and pay traffic fines.
traffic.eligibility: Log in with Singpass, or use a foreign vehicle number.
traffic.limits: Shows only offences issued by the Traffic Police. Cases still under investigation are not shown. Payment is only through the e-service or AXS.
